notes: Two separate causes. Natively, as in every earlier round, the agent tested its build and left /tmp/frame.bmp behind. Upstream's test accepts the existing frame at once, stops vm.js after one second, and fails test_vm_execution ("Expected text not found in output", the line 'I_InitGraphics: DOOM screen size: w x h: 320 x 200'), while both frame tests pass. SecureBench never captures /tmp, so N->S passes, and so does N->s->N: this is the scope difference too, recorded in CONVERSION.md.

New this round: the SecureBench agent's own attempt failed at capture, "symlink '/app/mips/build/toolchain/mipsel-none-elf-ar' has an absolute or malformed target", so S->N could not run. The agent's build script, mips/build.sh, made a toolchain folder of links under /app/mips/build. Its last run of the unchanged vm.js reached 'I_InitGraphics: DOOM screen size: w x h: 320 x 200' and wrote valid frames, so the ELF itself probably works; we cannot grade it, because nothing was captured. The rule is the framework's (capture rejects every absolute link target), and CONVERSION.md records that a link leaving /app fails capture where upstream would follow it, so this is stricter by design. It fails a leftover build folder, not the deliverable, like the .venv cases.
